title: WakeStudio model registry
description: Catalog of lazily-fetched models (ADR-011). Weights are never bundled with the PWA; the registry is the single source of truth for 'what model should be present locally' and drives the Phase 4 export license gate. Mirrors packages/platform/src/registry.ts (RegistryModel / ModelRegistry).

version.description: Registry format version (bump on breaking shape changes).

note.description: Human note about the registry (e.g. the lazy-fetch / license-gate policy).

registryModel.description: One lazily-fetched model. Field set mirrors RegistryModel in packages/platform/src/registry.ts.

tier.description: Target device tiers this model supports (ModelTier).

source.description: Origin / upstream repo of the model, e.g. 'dscripka/openWakeWord'.

url.description: Fetch URL. Module-owned assets use '/modules/<category>/<module>/assets/<rel>' (ADR-025); remote models use a full URL. 'TODO-phaseN' marks models not yet fetched.

license.description: SPDX-style license id (e.g. 'Apache-2.0', 'MIT', 'CC-BY-4.0'). Drives the export license gate.

commercial.description: Whether commercial use is permitted (drives the Phase 4 export gate).

class.description: Redistribution class (ModelClass): 'redistributable' = can be exported into user kits; 'demo-only' = demo purposes only (e.g. CC BY-NC-SA openWakeWord models).

sha256.description: Artifact integrity hash; 'TODO-phaseN' until verified (ADR-027). Null when unknown.

sizeBytes.description: Artifact size in bytes; null when unknown.

runtime.description: Execution runtime hint (ModelRuntime). Optional; onnxruntime-web is the default.

transformersModel.description: Hugging Face repo id for the transformers runtime (e.g. 'aaqibsaeed/plixkws').

externalData.description: For ONNX external-data exports: the co-located .data file name (e.g. 'plixkws-small.onnx.data').

notes.description: Human note (source detail, runtime behavior, fetch instructions).
